values.note: Every standard site has individual water and electric hookups; the park does not state the amperage. The designated tent area has central water.

hookups.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/sadlers-creek/camping ('52 sites are packed gravel with individual water and electrical hookups'; 'a designated tent camping area includes central water'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 51 standard water/electric sites on packed gravel (the page's prose says 52), 37 of them lakefront on Lake Hartwell, plus 14 designated tent sites and a primitive youth-group area. Some sites take RVs up to 40 ft.

sites.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/sadlers-creek/camping ('Standard Sites with Elec. & Water: 51 sites'; 'Designated Tent Sites: 14 sites'; '52 sites are packed gravel ...'; 'Some sites accommodate RV's up to 40 feet') + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/sadlers-creek/campsites ('one of 37 lakefront campground sites'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/sadlers-creek/camping ('The campground is convenient to restroom facilities with hot showers'; 'Dump Station: Yes'; 'No Wifi Available'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; per AWH's firsthand note on the state row, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum 14 nights per site (42 of 49 cumulative). Same-day reservations go through the park (864-226-8950). Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/sadlers-creek/camping ('Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; 'Reservations requested less than one (1) day in advance of check-in must be made directly through the park') + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/sadlers-creek/campsites (policies: 'Reservations may be made up to 13 months in advance', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 nights per site', check-in 2:00 p.m., check-out 12:00 p.m.), read 2026-10-21; single-night waiver from the state:SC row's AWH firsthand note

summary: Confirmed reservable on SC's own site with the 13-month window and 2-night minimum (now on the entry with the AWH phone waiver). Added water hookups (amperage not stated), 51 RV sites (37 lakefront) up to 40 ft, 14-night max, showers/dump, no Wi-Fi. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. AWH note kept. Not stated: amps, sewer, campground season, pull-throughs.
